name: Music Jingles
author: Kenney Vleugels (kenney.nl)
note: 17 short musical phrases (numbered 00-16), each recorded in five instrument timbres: HIT, NES, PIZZI, SAX, STEEL. The build treats each timbre as a style (arcade, 8bit, cozy, realistic, 16bit) and splits the 17 phrase numbers across the game/ flow categories (win, level-up, achievement, game-over, checkpoint) by index, since the filenames carry no semantic label beyond timbre and number.
